<reason>PRO kept a live comparative: bans export demand while regulated pay plus counsel, escrow, screening, and pre-birth parentage protect woman and child. CON's strongest impossibility claims - payment is coercion and enforceable versus humane - were met by threat versus offer, split enforceability, and kidney versus gestation distinction, while CON conceded non-enforcement and delivery-room parentage fights. Clipped Rebuttal 2 left CON's final weighing incomplete.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>A4.1-A4.2 answers to who signs and kidney analogy: stable mothers seeking high time-limited pay, screening acute crisis as normal labor protection, and pay for time-risk with ongoing consent versus pay to permanently harvest tissue, turned CON's best pressure and set up the altruistic-recruits-without-rights turnaround.</best_rebuttal>
